MalformedRangeProblemExample.summary: The `Range` header could not be parsed, or requests more than one range.

value.title: Bad content
value.detail: Could not parse 'Range' header: 'bytes=0-10,20-30'. Only a single range of the form 'bytes=<start>-<end>', 'bytes=<start>-' or 'bytes=-<suffixLength>' is supported.
